notes.title: SKIBIDI BACKROOMS v1.0 - 8 players in the lobby!
notes.content:
[h2]HELLO EVERYONE![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704197/c58d5d585a9c4d344c144387a1096dc792f04425.gif[/img]

[h2]We are pleased to announce that we are leaving early access. We settled on version 0.6 and completed all the main tasks for developing the game.
But this does not mean that we will stop developing and releasing updates![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704197/bb8159e0ab098a158c5e88ed0635f78f80cba3c2.png[/img]

[h2]It all depends on you, write reviews, put tags so that as many people as possible can see our game!
The larger the community and feedback, the more actively we will work on the next updates.[/h2]

store.steampowered.com/app/2515210/

[h3]RELEASE v1.0[/h3]

[list]
[*] 8 players in the lobby!
[*] All character models have been completely redesigned.
[*] The sound has been improved - it should now be more spacious.
[*] Fix voice chat.
[*] Improved translation into all languages.
[/list]

tags.feature: All character models have been completely redesigned.

notes.title: GAME RELEASE!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

[h2]So our project Corridor Amound of Fear came out.
Thanks everyone for participating in the beta test and supporting! Feedback from you allowed us to completely finalize the game.[/h2]
[h2]
In honor of the release of the game, we have set a 40% discount.[/h2]

[h2]We wish you a pleasant game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39046795/ca9ea6563e452c2b458dba1a66052fd92629e4b8.png[/img]

[h2]Bugs have been fixed in the final version:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [h3]The monster will no longer be able to pass through doors[/h3]
[*] [h3]Added icons for items that the player did not pick up.[/h3]
[/list]

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1461540/view/2925613388077413090]Also,don't forget about giveaway![/url][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39046795/771713ed82faf6a91df5b12f9527315fda9f63bb.png[/img]

Regards, Unreal Quality Games.[/h2]

notes.title: GIVEAWAY
notes.content:
[u][b][h2]UPD: The giveaway is over. For keys mail to [i]rosaspecialstuidio@gmail.com[/i]
Everyone gets the keys to who wrote the comment.[/h2][/b][/u]

[h1]Hello![/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39046795/771713ed82faf6a91df5b12f9527315fda9f63bb.png[/img]

[h3]In honor of the release, we are launching a giveaway for 50 keys. [/h3]
[h3]
All you need to do is:[/h3]

[h2][olist]
[*] "Subscribe" and "Add to Wishlist" the game. This way you can be the first to know about the news.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39046795/2745294edaaa848462450079f46d888c69f8647a.gif[/img]
[*] Rate Up and Leave a comment under this post.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39046795/ed15863fb3ecbae438c5ebfd4880096ff44d9e57.png[/img]
[/olist][/h2]

[h3]That's all you need to do. The results of the draw will be on November 25, 2020.

[h3]We are pleased to inform you that the game will be released on [b]November 24, 2020.[/b][/h3]

[h3]During beta testing, many bugs were identified and fixed. About [b]1000 players[/b] helped us in testing. We thank everyone who took part![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39046795/ca9ea6563e452c2b458dba1a66052fd92629e4b8.png[/img]

[h2]Play-test will end on November 22.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39046795/daad45eb3725086423368cf45ca639b275f44180.png[/img]

[u][b]As you can see, a trailer has appeared on the page in the store and the final assembly of the game is already available for closed beta testing.[/b][/u]

[previewyoutube=ERa0aPYTglo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Thank you all for your support.

Regards, Unreal Quality Games.[/b][/h3]
